note: Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest campground (Eagle River-Florence district) on the east shore of clear Spectacle Lake, with a 500-ft sandy swim beach, a boat landing and the 2.5-mile Spectacle-Kentuck trail to Kentuck Lake Campground. The lakeside sites (1-3, 5, 7, 9, 11) look at the lake through a line of trees. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov read. 34 sites (33 RV, 13 tent), per-site 25-40 ft, no hookups, vault + water, 17 reservable / 17 FCFS, 4-day cutoff, 14-night max; fees 15/15 -> 15/18 (lakeside $18). WATERFRONT LEAD lakefront -> lakeview. PIN MOVE ~660 m -> 46.0086,-89.0102. Season Apr 30-Oct 13 unchanged.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD lakefront -> lakeview: the lakeshore sites are 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 (recreation.gov 'Lakefront', FS '$18 lakeshore'). On Esri their points sit ~25-35 m from the shore (e.g. 007 46.00906,-89.01073; 009 46.00883,-89.01082; 011 46.00859,-89.01090) with a continuous band of conifers and shrubs along the water and, at the north end, a light track/trail line along the shore. The rec.gov photos of 1, 2, 3, 5, 9 and 11 all show the pad in the woods with the lake only glimpsed through a line of trees. Behind a line of trees = a view. All seven are sold by the night ($18; 2, 3, 9 reservable, the rest first-come).

PIN MOVE (~660 m): stored 46.0055,-89.0175 is southwest of the campground (on/over the lake's south shore area, away from every site point). Site centroid from the 34 rec.gov site points is 46.0086,-89.0102 (FS's own point 46.01028,-89.00917 is the north entrance end by sites 33-34). Target 46.0086,-89.0102.
SEASON: stored manual 04-30..10-13 matches the FS page; rec.gov's 2027 schedule runs 04-29..10-12.
STATUS: FS shows 'closed for the season' (ordinary end of season).
